text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho. What bloomed was neither 
gold nor pink— but a pure white, 
late-blooming chrysanthemum.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dwahahaha! Did ya see that? That's Tamamo 
Cross for ya! Who cares if I don't got raw 
power!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"With this much grit, I can win! From now 
on, call me 'Ritto's Obvious Weapon'!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait. That's a bit uncool. Hmmm, 
what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyoooone! It's me, Tamamo 
Cross, the 'Ritto's Secret Weapon'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she couldn't come up with a 
good phrase.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after the award ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Winning was definitely huge. But just as 
big was...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've carved Kyoto's 3000m into memory, 
plain as day! With these eyes, with these 
legs. The slopes, the curves, the 
straightaway, and just how brutal that 
final stretch is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross was muttering on the track. 
It was clear that she had some deep, 
personal feelings riding on this race.
choice_data_list: Tamamo, what are you aiming for?
Tamamo, what are you aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it's just personal stuff. Due to 
some minor circumstances, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pop quiz time! When it comes to 
long-distance GⅠs at Kyoto, there's the 
Kikuka Sho, and... what's the other one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, I think about it. The prime 
example that comes to mind is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There are folks who worship that 
race, the "Tenno Sho (Spring)," as the 
greatest race of all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's—me dad!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, they're traditional craftsmen 
through and through. Their passion for 
historic races is seriously no joke."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show 'em. In my absolute favorite 
race, runnin' my heart out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even if it's a little 
reckless, this time I gotta.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exhausted, Tamamo Cross grinned. It seemed 
this race was also a bit of practice for 
her family's sake.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on the victory. It's 
finally over, isn't it... the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City. Good work today. Thanks to you, 
it's been a great year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Before the Triple Crown, hearin' you talk 
about food kinda changed the way I look at 
things, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Bein' able to stand here is all thanks to 
ya, City. Much obliged."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I was the one... who gained courage from 
that toughness.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even when we weren't running together, I 
felt like we were running in the same 
race. The entire time..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, I suppose that's just how 
classmates are. There are things only we 
can share with each other.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know heaps of other folks, but... I'm 
real glad you're here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished running the Classic Road, 
the two now embark from here. Into the 
uncharted territory of races mixed with 
Classic and Senior divisions.
